comments.value:
If you're going to have such a list, I think you should link the relevant feature requests for these. 

Like make a forum or reddit post and link a bunch of cannys and try and get votes and attention on these.

For the menu, are you in desktop or VR? I'll open up the main menu and walk a step towards it some times. Obviously not a solution if you're in desktop mode or can move, but like that is two potential feature request, allow menu to take up more screen on pc, and for vr allow people to pull menu in closer

details:
-Menus can only be shrunken to smaller sizes and not increased to larger proportions to improve readability. The new menu is less legible than the original legacy one in some  ways.

-Brightness slider still only works in one direction and only lets you make worlds darker, not brighter.

-World post processing and can still be used to abuse users with underlying photosensitivity issues. There are no options to avoid effects that are intended to cause motion sickness, or attempt to induce a seizure in a player if they are implemented at a world level. There is no way to know if a world will effect you negatively in this manner before visiting it.

-There is not system to tag worlds based on their creator implemented accessibility, since vrc gave up on actually implementing proper accessibility features after the post-eac outrage died down and expects users to add it themselves now.

-There is no system to tag publicly available avatars based on accessibility features. This should be considered a necessity since vrc expects creators to implement accessibility for them now.

-There are no options to resize menu text or tooltip text. This is a basic feature in most software since windows 98.
title: Accessibility is still woefully inflexible. VRC expects users to add it themselves now.
